questions.stem: Con la pista «Apply the rule for a final-stressed word / Check the final letter first. / A written accent on a word whose last syllable is…», ¿qué opción se ajusta realmente al fragmento?

options.text: A word ending in a consonant other than n or s with stress on the last syllable

options.text: A word ending in a vowel with stress on the last syllable
